changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to consistent capitalization, removed duplicate/overly verbose dataset descriptions, simplified output description. Added Clinical Longformer model mentioned in experiments.
Normalized metric names to base forms without score/suffix. Removed Neg F1 and MaF1 as they are variations of F1 score rather than distinct metrics.
The paper does not use LLMs as judges after generation. LLMs are only used for summarization, not for evaluating generated outputs.
The paper mentions manual evaluation would be 'not scalable and is subjective' and explicitly states they developed a data-driven approach instead. No human evaluation was conducted.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on aspect-oriented summarization for clinical text and evaluates the downstream task performance (readmission prediction) rather than directly evaluating the quality of generated summaries. Evaluation is focused on prediction performance metrics rather than NLG quality metrics.
